"""Train probes on MV/TWV/HMM labels, cross-evaluate on conf>=2 MV test set."""

import sys
import torch
import random
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
import torch.nn as nn

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from probe_model import ProgressProbe, WindowDataset, collate_fn, split_by_instance
from train_probe import compute_metrics, set_seed, evaluate_epoch, EarlyStopping

BASE = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/agent_progress_probe")


def train_one(data_dir, output_dir, seed=42, epochs=20, device="cuda"):
    set_seed(seed)
    output_dir = Path(output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    data = torch.load(Path(data_dir) / "embeddings.pt", weights_only=False)
    embeddings = data["embeddings"]
    labels = data["labels"]
    instance_ids = data["instance_ids"]
    embed_dim = data["embed_dim"]

    train_idx, val_idx, test_idx = split_by_instance(instance_ids, seed=seed)

    def subset(indices):
        return WindowDataset([embeddings[i] for i in indices], [labels[i] for i in indices])

    train_ds, val_ds = subset(train_idx), subset(val_idx)

    train_labels = [labels[i] for i in train_idx]
    num_pos = sum(train_labels)
    num_neg = len(train_labels) - num_pos
    pos_weight = torch.tensor([num_neg / max(num_pos, 1)]).to(device)
    print(f"  Train: {len(train_ds)} (pos={num_pos}, neg={num_neg}, pw={pos_weight.item():.3f})")
    print(f"  Val: {len(val_ds)}, Test: {len(test_idx)}")

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=32, collate_fn=collate_fn)

    model = ProgressProbe(embed_dim=embed_dim).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=0.01)
    criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=pos_weight)
    es = EarlyStopping(patience=5)

    for epoch in range(1, epochs + 1):
        model.train()
        total_loss, n = 0.0, 0
        for padded, bl, lengths in train_loader:
            logits = model(padded.to(device), lengths)
            loss = criterion(logits, bl.to(device))
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(bl)
            n += len(bl)

        vm = evaluate_epoch(model, val_loader, device)
        best = es.step(vm["macro_f1"])
        print(f"  Epoch {epoch:2d} | loss={total_loss/n:.4f} | val_F1={vm['macro_f1']:.4f}{' *' if best else ''}")
        if best:
            torch.save({"model_state_dict": model.state_dict(), "embed_dim": embed_dim,
                         "hidden_size": 256, "num_layers": 2, "epoch": epoch,
                         "val_macro_f1": vm["macro_f1"]}, output_dir / "best_model.pt")
        if es.should_stop:
            print(f"  Early stop epoch {epoch}")
            break

    ckpt = torch.load(output_dir / "best_model.pt", weights_only=False)
    model.load_state_dict(ckpt["model_state_dict"])
    return model, test_idx, embed_dim


def eval_on_labels(model, data_dir, indices, device, min_conf=0):
    data = torch.load(Path(data_dir) / "embeddings.pt", weights_only=False)
    embs = data["embeddings"]
    labels = data["labels"]
    confs = data.get("confidences", [1] * len(labels))

    sel = [i for i in indices if confs[i] >= min_conf]
    if not sel:
        return {}
    ds = WindowDataset([embs[i] for i in sel], [labels[i] for i in sel])
    loader = DataLoader(ds, batch_size=64, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    return evaluate_epoch(model, loader, device)


def main():
    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    print(f"Device: {device}")
    results = {}

    configs = [
        ("mv",  BASE / "data",          BASE / "checkpoints_tlm_mv"),
        ("twv", BASE / "data_tlm_twv",  BASE / "checkpoints_tlm_twv"),
        ("hmm", BASE / "data_tlm_hmm",  BASE / "checkpoints_tlm_hmm"),
    ]

    models = {}
    test_idx = None
    for name, ddir, odir in configs:
        print(f"\n{'='*40}\n  Training: {name.upper()} ({ddir})\n{'='*40}")
        model, tidx, edim = train_one(ddir, odir, seed=42, device=device)
        models[name] = model
        if test_idx is None:
            test_idx = tidx

        # Self-eval
        self_m = eval_on_labels(model, ddir, test_idx, device)
        results[f"{name}_self"] = self_m
        print(f"  Self-test: macro_f1={self_m['macro_f1']:.4f} acc={self_m['accuracy']:.4f}")

        # Cross-eval on MV conf>=2
        cross_m = eval_on_labels(model, BASE / "data", test_idx, device, min_conf=2)
        results[f"{name}_mv_conf2"] = cross_m
        print(f"  MV conf>=2: macro_f1={cross_m.get('macro_f1',0):.4f} acc={cross_m.get('accuracy',0):.4f}")

        # Cross-eval on MV all
        cross_all = eval_on_labels(model, BASE / "data", test_idx, device, min_conf=0)
        results[f"{name}_mv_all"] = cross_all
        print(f"  MV all:     macro_f1={cross_all.get('macro_f1',0):.4f} acc={cross_all.get('accuracy',0):.4f}")

    # Summary
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  {'Method':<8} {'Self F1':>8} {'MV-all F1':>10} {'MV-c2 F1':>10} {'MV-c2 Acc':>10}")
    print(f"  {'-'*48}")
    for name in ["mv", "twv", "hmm"]:
        sf = results[f"{name}_self"]["macro_f1"]
        af = results[f"{name}_mv_all"]["macro_f1"]
        cf = results[f"{name}_mv_conf2"].get("macro_f1", 0)
        ca = results[f"{name}_mv_conf2"].get("accuracy", 0)
        print(f"  {name.upper():<8} {sf:>8.4f} {af:>10.4f} {cf:>10.4f} {ca:>10.4f}")

    # Per-class detail for cross-eval
    print(f"\n  Cross-eval detail (MV conf>=2 test set):")
    print(f"  {'Method':<8} {'F1_stag':>8} {'F1_prog':>8} {'Prec':>8} {'Rec':>8}")
    print(f"  {'-'*40}")
    for name in ["mv", "twv", "hmm"]:
        m = results[f"{name}_mv_conf2"]
        print(f"  {name.upper():<8} {m.get('f1_stagnation',0):>8.4f} {m.get('f1_progress',0):>8.4f} "
              f"{m.get('precision_macro',0):>8.4f} {m.get('recall_macro',0):>8.4f}")

    out_path = BASE / "artifacts" / "temporal-label-model" / "probe_comparison.json"
    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\n  Saved to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        to_prog = sum(1 for a, b in zip(sub_mv, sub_tlm) if a == 0 and b == 1)
        by_conf[c] = {
            "n": nc, "agreement": round(agr / nc, 4),
            "to_stag": to_stag, "to_prog": to_prog,
            "flip_rate": round((to_stag + to_prog) / nc, 4)
        }
    
    # Disagreement patterns
    disagree_idx = [i for i in range(n) if mv_labels[i] != tlm_labels[i]]
    patterns = Counter()
    for i in disagree_idx:
        p = tuple(windows[i]["labels"][lf] for lf in LF_NAMES)
        patterns[p] += 1

        "n_windows": n,
        "mv_agreement": round(agree / n, 4),

        "tlm_dist": {"stag": tlm_dist[0], "prog": tlm_dist[1]},
        "by_confidence": by_conf,
        "n_disagreements": len(disagree_idx),
        "top_disagree_patterns": [
            {"pattern": dict(zip(LF_NAMES, p)), "count": c}
            for p, c in patterns.most_common(5)
        ]
    }


def create_training_data(windows, tlm_labels, dirname):
    orig = torch.load(DATA / "embeddings.pt", weights_only=False)
    orig_labels = orig["labels"]
    
    out_dir = BASE / dirname
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    new_labels = list(tlm_labels)
    changed = sum(1 for a, b in zip(orig_labels, new_labels) if a != b)
    
    new_data = dict(orig)
    new_data["labels"] = new_labels
    torch.save(new_data, out_dir / "embeddings.pt")
    
    ns = sum(1 for l in new_labels if l == 0)
    np_ = sum(1 for l in new_labels if l == 1)
    print(f"  {dirname}: changed {changed}/{len(new_labels)} ({100*changed/len(new_labels):.1f}%), stag={ns} prog={np_}")
    return out_dir


def train_probe_on_labels(data_dir, output_dir, seed=42, epochs=20, device="cpu"):
    set_seed(seed)
    output_dir = Path(output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    data = torch.load(Path(data_dir) / "embeddings.pt", weights_only=False)
    embeddings = data["embeddings"]
    labels = data["labels"]
    instance_ids = data["instance_ids"]
    embed_dim = data["embed_dim"]

    train_idx, val_idx, test_idx = split_by_instance(instance_ids, seed=seed)

    def subset(indices):
        return WindowDataset([embeddings[i] for i in indices], [labels[i] for i in indices])

    train_ds, val_ds = subset(train_idx), subset(val_idx)

    train_labels = [labels[i] for i in train_idx]
    num_pos = sum(train_labels)
    num_neg = len(train_labels) - num_pos
    pos_weight = torch.tensor([num_neg / max(num_pos, 1)]).to(device)

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=32, collate_fn=collate_fn)

    model = ProgressProbe(embed_dim=embed_dim).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=0.01)
    criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=pos_weight)
    es = EarlyStopping(patience=5)

    for epoch in range(1, epochs + 1):
        model.train()
        total_loss, n = 0.0, 0
        for padded, bl, lengths in train_loader:
            logits = model(padded.to(device), lengths)
            loss = criterion(logits, bl.to(device))
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(bl)
            n += len(bl)

        vm = evaluate_epoch(model, val_loader, device)
        best = es.step(vm["macro_f1"])
        if best:
            torch.save({"model_state_dict": model.state_dict(), "embed_dim": embed_dim},
                       output_dir / "best_model.pt")
        if es.should_stop:
            print(f"    Early stop epoch {epoch}, best val_F1={es.best_score:.4f}")
            break

    ckpt = torch.load(output_dir / "best_model.pt", weights_only=False)
    model.load_state_dict(ckpt["model_state_dict"])
    return model, test_idx, embed_dim


def eval_probe(model, data_dir, indices, device, min_conf=0):
    data = torch.load(Path(data_dir) / "embeddings.pt", weights_only=False)
    embs = data["embeddings"]
    labels = data["labels"]
    confs = data.get("confidences", [1] * len(labels))

    sel = [i for i in indices if confs[i] >= min_conf]
    if not sel:
        return {}
    ds = WindowDataset([embs[i] for i in sel], [labels[i] for i in sel])
    loader = DataLoader(ds, batch_size=64, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    return evaluate_epoch(model, loader, device)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Comprehensive TLM comparison: MV, TWV, HMM, Lag-HMM, FlyingSquid, Snorkel.

Uses predict() instead of predict_proba() for FlyingSquid (much faster).
"""

import json
import sys
import time
import random
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from probe_model import ProgressProbe, WindowDataset, collate_fn, split_by_instance
from train_probe import set_seed, evaluate_epoch, EarlyStopping

BASE = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/agent_progress_probe")
DATA = BASE / "data"
OUT = BASE / "artifacts" / "tlm-comparison"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

LF_NAMES = ["file_diff_delta", "command_repetition", "outcome_backpropagation"]


def load_windows():
    windows = []
    with open(DATA / "windows_labeled.jsonl") as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.strip():
                windows.append(json.loads(line))
    usable = [w for w in windows if w.get("majority_label", -1) != -1]
    return usable


def build_lf_matrix_snorkel(windows):
    """Snorkel convention: 0=stagnation, 1=progress, -1=abstain."""
    N = len(windows)
    L = np.full((N, len(LF_NAMES)), -1, dtype=int)
    for i, w in enumerate(windows):
        for j, lf in enumerate(LF_NAMES):
            v = w["labels"][lf]
            if v == 0:
                L[i, j] = 0
            elif v == 1:
                L[i, j] = 1
    return L


def build_lf_matrix_fs(windows):
    """FlyingSquid convention: +1=progress, -1=stagnation, 0=abstain."""
    N = len(windows)
    L = np.zeros((N, len(LF_NAMES)), dtype=int)
    for i, w in enumerate(windows):
        for j, lf in enumerate(LF_NAMES):
            v = w["labels"][lf]
            if v == 1:
                L[i, j] = 1
            elif v == 0:
                L[i, j] = -1
            else:
                L[i, j] = 0
    return L


def run_flyingsquid(windows):
    import logging
    logging.getLogger("pgmpy").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
    from flyingsquid.label_model import LabelModel as FSLabelModel
    
    L = build_lf_matrix_fs(windows)
    lm = FSLabelModel(m=len(LF_NAMES))
    print("  Fitting FS model...", flush=True)
    lm.fit(L)
    print("  Predicting (using predict, not predict_proba)...", flush=True)
    # predict returns +1/-1 labels
    raw_preds = lm.predict(L)
    labels = [1 if p > 0 else 0 for p in raw_preds]
    return labels


def run_snorkel(windows):
    from snorkel.labeling.model import LabelModel as SnorkelLM
    L = build_lf_matrix_snorkel(windows)
    lm = SnorkelLM(cardinality=2, verbose=False)
    print("  Fitting Snorkel model...", flush=True)
    lm.fit(L_train=L, n_epochs=500, lr=0.01, log_freq=500, seed=42)
    print("  Predicting...", flush=True)
    preds = lm.predict(L)
    labels = [int(p) for p in preds]
    proba = lm.predict_proba(L)
    return labels, proba, lm


def analyze_labels(windows, tlm_labels, name):
    mv_labels = [w["majority_label"] for w in windows]
    n = len(windows)
    agree = sum(1 for a, b in zip(mv_labels, tlm_labels) if a == b)
    
    mv_dist = Counter(mv_labels)
    tlm_dist = Counter(tlm_labels)
    
    by_conf = {}
    for c in [1, 2, 3]:
        mask = [w["confidence"] == c for w in windows]
        nc = sum(mask)
        if nc == 0:
            continue
        sub_mv = [m for m, k in zip(mv_labels, mask) if k]
        sub_tlm = [t for t, k in zip(tlm_labels, mask) if k]
        agr = sum(1 for a, b in zip(sub_mv, sub_tlm) if a == b)
        to_stag = sum(1 for a, b in zip(sub_mv, sub_tlm) if a == 1 and b == 0)
        to_prog = sum(1 for a, b in zip(sub_mv, sub_tlm) if a == 0 and b == 1)
        by_conf[c] = {
            "n": nc, "agreement": round(agr / nc, 4),
            "to_stag": to_stag, "to_prog": to_prog,
            "flip_rate": round((to_stag + to_prog) / nc, 4)
        }
    
    disagree_idx = [i for i in range(n) if mv_labels[i] != tlm_labels[i]]
    patterns = Counter()
    for i in disagree_idx:
        p = tuple(windows[i]["labels"][lf] for lf in LF_NAMES)
        patterns[p] += 1
    
    all_to_stag = all(mv_labels[i] == 1 and tlm_labels[i] == 0 for i in disagree_idx)
    all_to_prog = all(mv_labels[i] == 0 and tlm_labels[i] == 1 for i in disagree_idx)
    
    return {
        "name": name,
        "n_windows": n,
        "mv_agreement": round(agree / n, 4),
        "mv_dist": {"stag": mv_dist[0], "prog": mv_dist[1]},
        "tlm_dist": {"stag": tlm_dist[0], "prog": tlm_dist[1]},
        "by_confidence": by_conf,
        "n_disagreements": len(disagree_idx),
        "all_to_stag": all_to_stag,
        "all_to_prog": all_to_prog,
        "top_disagree_patterns": [
            {"pattern": dict(zip(LF_NAMES, p)), "count": c}
            for p, c in patterns.most_common(10)
        ]
    }


def create_training_data(windows, tlm_labels, dirname):
    orig = torch.load(DATA / "embeddings.pt", weights_only=False)
    
    out_dir = BASE / dirname
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    new_labels = list(tlm_labels)
    changed = sum(1 for a, b in zip(orig["labels"], new_labels) if a != b)
    
    new_data = dict(orig)
    new_data["labels"] = new_labels
    torch.save(new_data, out_dir / "embeddings.pt")
    
    ns = sum(1 for l in new_labels if l == 0)
    np_ = sum(1 for l in new_labels if l == 1)
    print(f"  {dirname}: changed {changed}/{len(new_labels)} ({100*changed/len(new_labels):.1f}%), stag={ns} prog={np_}")
    return out_dir


def train_probe_on_labels(data_dir, output_dir, seed=42, epochs=20, device="cpu"):
    set_seed(seed)
    output_dir = Path(output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    data = torch.load(Path(data_dir) / "embeddings.pt", weights_only=False)
    embeddings = data["embeddings"]
    labels = data["labels"]
    instance_ids = data["instance_ids"]
    embed_dim = data["embed_dim"]

    train_idx, val_idx, test_idx = split_by_instance(instance_ids, seed=seed)

    def subset(indices):
        return WindowDataset([embeddings[i] for i in indices], [labels[i] for i in indices])

    train_ds, val_ds = subset(train_idx), subset(val_idx)

    train_labels = [labels[i] for i in train_idx]
    num_pos = sum(train_labels)
    num_neg = len(train_labels) - num_pos
    pos_weight = torch.tensor([num_neg / max(num_pos, 1)]).to(device)
    print(f"    Train: {len(train_ds)} (pos={num_pos}, neg={num_neg}, pw={pos_weight.item():.3f})")

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=32, collate_fn=collate_fn)

    model = ProgressProbe(embed_dim=embed_dim).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=0.01)
    criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=pos_weight)
    es = EarlyStopping(patience=5)

    best_epoch = 0
    for epoch in range(1, epochs + 1):
        model.train()
        total_loss, n = 0.0, 0
        for padded, bl, lengths in train_loader:
            logits = model(padded.to(device), lengths)
            loss = criterion(logits, bl.to(device))
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(bl)
            n += len(bl)

        vm = evaluate_epoch(model, val_loader, device)
        best = es.step(vm["macro_f1"])
        if best:
            best_epoch = epoch
            torch.save({"model_state_dict": model.state_dict(), "embed_dim": embed_dim},
                       output_dir / "best_model.pt")
        if es.should_stop:
            print(f"    Early stop epoch {epoch}, best val_F1={es.best_score:.4f} (ep {best_epoch})")
            break

    if not es.should_stop:
        print(f"    Finished {epochs} epochs, best val_F1={es.best_score:.4f} (ep {best_epoch})")

    ckpt = torch.load(output_dir / "best_model.pt", weights_only=False)
    model.load_state_dict(ckpt["model_state_dict"])
    return model, test_idx, embed_dim

    embs = data["embeddings"]
    labels = data["labels"]
    confs = data.get("confidences", [1] * len(labels))

    sel = [i for i in indices if confs[i] >= min_conf]
    if not sel:
        return {}
    ds = WindowDataset([embs[i] for i in sel], [labels[i] for i in sel])
    loader = DataLoader(ds, batch_size=64, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    return evaluate_epoch(model, loader, device)
